goal: Separate low-level socket I/O from P2P protocol rules to simplify network code
Allow socket event polling to be reused by services such as Stratum v2 or an embedded HTTP server
Speed up peer lookups from linear to constant time
reviewability: Author inactive for over 200 days, so review responses may be delayed
agreement: Architectural objection: wrong abstraction level and ill-suited for HTTP or SV2 (theuni)
Unaddressed safety objection: returning raw node pointers risks dangling references (hodlinator)
Code review approval finding simplified networking and portable transport logic (ryanofsky)
Tested peer connections across multiple platforms and signet (pinheadmz, Sjors)
Concept approval without stated reasons (jonatack, tdb3)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it addresses longstanding structural coupling between socket I/O and P2P connection logic
High maintainability leverage across node networking that can unblock modular reuse in other services
